topic: inflate a basketball to correct pressure
core_question: How do you inflate a sports ball, like a basketball, to the right pressure?
answer_summary: Wet the inflation needle, insert it into the valve, and pump air in gradually while checking a pressure gauge against the recommended PSI printed on the ball, stopping once it matches.
persona: tired and blunt; writing terse one-liners
